chapter: Family and the lake excursion boats
title: The Camellia: Ernie's father the night watchman, and its sinking
summary: Ernie's father was night watchman on the Camellia at the shipyard, and Ernie and his little brother played on board. People later lived on it and it sank, and they plan to photograph the picture.
